description: Create a PRIVATE non-custodial swap routed through Monero (dual-leg: your coin -> XMR -> target coin). Breaks the on-chain link between sender and receiver - no direct trace. You receive the target coin at your own address. ~15-30 min. Returns payinAddress (send your source coin here) + estimatedAmount + legs. from/to must NOT be xmr and must differ.

address.description: Destination address to receive the target coin

from.description: Source asset ticker (e.g. sol, btc, eth, usdt)

name: private_swap
